text: DSH Web Search AnySearch 是面向 web 客户端的搜索提供方插件，在 DSH 的 web 搜索接口注册 AnySearch 后端，并在 Plugins 设置卡片中提供搜索服务切换。用户可以将 web_search 的请求交给 AnySearch，也可以切换到官方 DeepSeek 搜索；卡片还可编辑 AnySearch 接口地址和 API Key，保存后后续搜索采用新配置。适合希望通过 DSH 统一使用或切换网页搜索服务的用户。AnySearch 可匿名访问，API Key 可选；查询会发送到所选搜索服务。

DSH Web Search AnySearch adds AnySearch to DSH web search and a Plugins settings card. Users can route web_search to AnySearch or official DeepSeek search, and set the AnySearch endpoint and API key. AnySearch allows anonymous access, so the key is optional. Queries go to the selected service.
想让 DSH 的 web_search 使用 AnySearch。
我想在设置页切换网页搜索服务。
能不能让 DSH 改用官方 DeepSeek 搜索？
我需要给 DSH 配置网页搜索接口地址和密钥。
I want to switch which web search service DSH uses.
Can DSH send web_search queries to AnySearch?
DSH Web Search AnySearch 的「切换搜索后端」功能：在 Plugins 设置卡片选择 AnySearch 或官方 DeepSeek 搜索并保存；后续 web_search 请求按当前选择路由到对应后端。
DSH Web Search AnySearch 的「配置 AnySearch 接口」功能：在设置卡片编辑 AnySearch 接口地址和 API Key 并保存；提供方随后将搜索查询提交到配置的 AnySearch 搜索端点。
DSH Web Search AnySearch 使用前须知：查询会发送到所选搜索服务；AnySearch API Key 可选。（见 src/provider.ts:3-5）

@wenqi_bian/dsh-web-search-anysearch README · AnySearch for DeepSeek Harness：dsh exposes one model-facing `web_search` tool and picks its backend through the `ctx.web` seam. This bundle registers a provider under the `anysearch` id: it calls `POST https://api.anysearch.com/v1/search` when AnySearch is selected, and delegates to the official DeepSeek search endpoint when it is not. Anonymous AnySearch access works; an API key raises the rate limit.

@wenqi_bian/dsh-web-search-anysearch README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @wenqi_bian/dsh-web-search-anysearch@alpha
```

Restart `dsh web` afterwards: profile bundles and the served browser half are read at startup. Inspect the composed tree without booting:

```bash
dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

@wenqi_bian/dsh-web-search-anysearch README · Install：Each plugin release carries the exact version of the dsh tag it targets and ships prebuilt host and browser halves. `alpha` tracks the current release; pin one exactly with `@wenqi_bian/dsh-web-search-anysearch@0.2.1-rc.5`. Hosts below the supported floor pin the frozen line explicitly: `dsh plugin --profile web add @wenqi_bian/dsh-web-search-anysearch@0.1.2-rc.1`.

@wenqi_bian/dsh-web-search-anysearch README · Install：Upgrading from a hand-written row: delete any existing `web-search-anysearch` entry from your profile patch before installing the bundle. The bundle adds the same row id, and duplicate ids fail the load.

@wenqi_bian/dsh-web-search-anysearch README · Quickstart：AnySearch needs no credential. To raise its rate limit, type the key into the card's **API key** field, which stores it in the credentials domain, or put it there yourself under the `ANYSEARCH_API_KEY` reference (see [Configuration](#configuration)).

@wenqi_bian/dsh-web-search-anysearch README · Quickstart：On dsh `0.1.7-alpha.1` and later, including the `0.2.x` line, both the bundle's own page and the row's page carry this form. On `0.1.6-alpha.2` it is the bundle's own page; on the `0.1.5` line it is **Settings → Plugins → Plugin configuration → AnySearch 搜索服务**.

@wenqi_bian/dsh-web-search-anysearch README · Compatibility：The supported range starts at dsh `v0.1.5-alpha.1`, and the CI matrix verifies every published release inside it: the five `0.1.5` tags (`alpha.1`, `alpha.2`, `rc.1`, `rc.2`, `rc.3`), `0.1.6-alpha.2`, the four `0.1.7` tags (`alpha.1`, `alpha.2`, `rc.1`, `rc.2`), `0.2.0-rc.2`, and the five `0.2.1` tags (`rc.1` through `rc.5`). Within the `0.2.0` line the floor is `v0.2.0-rc.2` itself: `v0.2.0-rc.1` is refused. Within the `0.2.1` line the floor is `v0.2.1-rc.1`; the `0.2.1` alpha releases are not part of the claim. The `0.1.2` line and `v0.1.3-alpha.2` are not supported: pin `0.1.3-alpha.2` or `0.1.2-rc.1` if your harness is older, and note that `v0.1.6-alpha.1` sits below the floor. dsh never published a `0.1.4`.

@wenqi_bian/dsh-web-search-anysearch README · Compatibility：**The admission gate.** Since `v0.1.7-rc.1`, dsh reads a plugin's dsh requirement before importing it — its `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer ranges, or `engines.dsh` where one is declared — and refuses a bundle, or blocks a row, whose requirement does not accept the running version. The declared range is the whole compatibility claim, so this package names each verified line: `^0.1.5-alpha.1 || ^0.1.6-alpha.2 || ^0.1.7-alpha.1 || ^0.2.0-rc.2 || ^0.2.1-rc.1`. The `0.2.0` line is where those ranges stopped covering the runtime, which is why `v0.2.0-rc.1` and `v0.2.0-rc.2` were refused before the `0.2.0` release; the `0.2.1` line adds its five `rc` tags to that claim. A runtime outside the range is refused on purpose, with the incompatible peers printed and `dsh plugin allow-version` offered as the exact-version exemption.

@wenqi_bian/dsh-web-search-anysearch README · Compatibility：Two contracts underneath that range have two shapes each, and this build detects which one is installed rather than branching on a version string:

@wenqi_bian/dsh-web-search-anysearch README · Compatibility：- **Settings.** Through `0.1.6-alpha.2` a plugin registered its section with `ctx.settings.installSection(...)`. From `0.1.7-alpha.1` that call is gone: a schema field marked `.volatile()` reaches `apply` as a stable reference whose `get()` returns the live value, so a committed edit re-routes the next search instead of remounting the plugin.
- **Plugins page.** `0.1.6-alpha.2` renders a bundle's own configuration page; `0.1.7-alpha.1` and later render both that page and a row's page, where the entry's live values arrive as owner props. The browser half registers into all three slots this range has known and stays dormant where a deployment declares none. The bundle's own page supplies no form, so the card binds the namespace's configuration form itself (`ctx.configForms` on `0.1.7-alpha.1` and later, `ctx.settingsScope` before that); the row's page keeps using the form the page hands down.

@wenqi_bian/dsh-web-search-anysearch README · Configuration：| Config key | Control | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `searchProvider` | Backend switch | `anysearch` | Which backend serves the next `web_search`: `anysearch` or `deepseek-official`. |
| `apiKeyEnv` | API key field | `ANYSEARCH_API_KEY` | Where the card stores a typed key, in the credentials domain. The reference is resolved per search. Only names beginning with `ANYSEARCH_` are resolved; a foreign or malformed name makes the provider unavailable instead of addressing another plugin's secret. |
| `apiKey` | | unset | A literal key written into the profile by hand. It wins over the reference and is redacted over the wire by its `secret` role. |
| `baseURL` | Endpoint field | `https://api.anysearch.com` | AnySearch base; `/v1/search` is appended. Overridden by `ANYSEARCH_API_BASE_URL`. The host requires HTTPS with a public destination: HTTP, embedded credentials, localhost names, private/loopback literals, redirects, query strings or fragments, port 80, and URLs over 2048 characters are refused. |

@wenqi_bian/dsh-web-search-anysearch README · Configuration：The credential domain resolves a reference in this order: `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`, then `$DSH_HOME/.env`, then the inherited environment. Leave both key fields unset to search anonymously.

@wenqi_bian/dsh-web-search-anysearch README · Configuration：The resolved key and the query are both sent to the configured endpoint, so the endpoint is part of the credential's trust boundary: the provider refuses any endpoint outside the transport policy above, never follows a redirect, caps the response body at 2 MB, and caps each snippet at 1000 characters. Before dispatch the host also resolves the endpoint hostname once and refuses a non-public answer (reserved offline TLDs such as `.example` are skipped); the connection is not pinned to that answer, so a DNS answer that changes between the check and the connection remains a residual risk. Pointing `baseURL` at a host you trust is still a configuration decision the user owns.

@wenqi_bian/dsh-web-search-anysearch README · Configuration：The switch also has three non-GUI equivalents, and later layers win over the bundle's own pin of `web.searchProvider: anysearch`:

```yaml

@wenqi_bian/dsh-web-search-anysearch README · $DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml：- id: web
  config:
    searchProvider: anysearch          # or deepseek-official
    fetchProvider: http                # the patch replaces the whole config
```

The bundle layer also pins `web.fetchProvider: http`; a later patch layer that replaces the whole `web` row must restate both fields.

```bash
dsh web --patch examples/use-deepseek-official.cordis.yml
DSH_WEB_SEARCH_PROVIDER=anysearch dsh web
```

@wenqi_bian/dsh-web-search-anysearch README · $DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml：Whichever layer pins it, a pin that names another provider (for example `exa`) takes this card out of the serving path entirely.
